description: Incumbent brands respond to Meridian entry with aggressive price cuts, increased promotions, or retailer incentives to block shelf space.
mitigation: Secure distribution agreements before public launch. Focus on underpenetrated areas where HUL presence is weaker. Build retailer loyalty through higher margins in Year 1.

description: Kirana adoption takes longer than Aurangabad precedent. Ramp factor assumptions prove optimistic — breakeven pushed beyond Month 14.
mitigation: Hire experienced local distributor with existing kirana relationships. Set Month 3 distribution coverage milestone — if below 40%, trigger contingency BTL spend.

description: Nagpur consumers show stronger brand loyalty to HUL than Aurangabad benchmark suggests. Market share ramp takes 6-9 months longer than projected.
mitigation: Invest in product sampling campaigns in Month 1-3. Price Personal Care SKUs at 5% below HUL for first 6 months to drive trial. Monitor weekly sell-through rates.

description: Local body approvals, FSSAI compliance, or distributor registration delays push launch date by 1-3 months. Misses Diwali window.
mitigation: Begin regulatory process 4 months before planned launch. Engage local legal counsel familiar with Nagpur municipal requirements. Build 6-week buffer into launch timeline.

description: Competitive intensity forces higher than budgeted marketing spend to achieve trial and visibility. Capex ceiling of ₹12 crore breached.
mitigation: Ring-fence ₹1 crore contingency within capex budget. Monthly BTL spend review against distribution milestones. Shift spend from ATL to targeted BTL if overrun detected.

description: Freight costs increase due to fuel price hikes or supply chain disruptions on NH44. Current model assumes ₹6,010/MT total cost.
mitigation: Lock in 12-month freight rate contract with logistics partner before entry. Evaluate owned vehicle fleet feasibility after Month 12.

description: Field sales representatives leave within first 6 months or fail to meet distribution targets. Ramp factor directly impacted.
mitigation: Hire 2 additional reps as buffer beyond the 8 planned. Link incentive structure to distribution coverage milestones. Monthly performance review with clear targets.

description: Inflation or economic slowdown reduces discretionary FMCG spending in SEC B+C households. TAM and revenue assumptions overestimated.
mitigation: Maintain value SKUs (Noodles, Biscuits) at competitive price points as defensive play. Monitor RBI inflation data quarterly and adjust projections accordingly.
